prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Miami for hurricane-rated roof replacement?
ai_overview_text:
Top-rated companies in Miami for hurricane-rated and high-wind roof replacements include Extreme Roofing Inc., Estrada Roofing, MIW Roofing, and Atlas Builders & Development, all of which adhere strictly to Miami-Dade High-Velocity Hurricane Zone (HVHZ) building codes. www.extremeroofingmiami.com +3
Credentials: GAF Master Elite, BBB A+ rated, My Safe Florida Home certified (License CCC1326021, family-owned since 2004).
Services: Residential and commercial metal and tile roofs, waterproofing, and insurance claim assistance.
Details: Offers free estimates and promotional discounts up to $10,000 off eligible installations. Visit Extreme Roofing Inc. for more information.
Miami-Dade HVHZ Compliance: Your replacement must use materials and installation methods specifically approved for High-Velocity Hurricane Zones to pass county inspections and withstand extreme wind uplift.
Secondary Water Resistance (SWR): Ask contractors about installing a self-adhering "peel-and-stick" underlayment directly to the roof deck as a crucial backup seal if exterior shingles or tiles blow off. Superior Roofing Services of South Florida
Wind Mitigation Credits: Upgrading to a code-compliant, impact-rated metal roof or properly fastened tile system can drastically lower your homeowner insurance premiums in Florida. Superior Roofing Services of South Florida
Average Cost: Full residential roof replacements in Miami-Dade generally range from $14,000 to $32,000, depending on your home's square footage, roof pitch, and chosen material (shingle, tile, or metal). Art's Roofing & Construction
